an7.83:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Upāli yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Upāli Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an7.83:2.1: ‘sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yam ahaṃ Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyan' ti. 2.
an7.83:2.2: Ye kho tvaṃ Upāli dhamme jāneyyāsi:
an7.83:2.3: ime dhammā na ekantanibbidhāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantī ti,
an7.83:2.5: n' eso dhammo, n' eso vinayo, n' etaṃ Satthu sāsanan ti.
an7.83:2.6: Ye ca kho tvaṃ Upāli dhamme jāneyyāsi:
an7.83:2.7: ime dhammā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantī ti,
an7.83:2.9: eso dhammo, eso vinayo, etaṃ Satthu sāsanan ti. 1.
